pages.title: Battery replacement
pages.content: Back up data. Power down. Remove charger. Open case. Disconnect battery cable. Remove battery pack. Install new battery. Run battery health checks.

pages.title: Penggantian baterai
pages.content: Cadangkan data. Matikan. Cabut charger. Buka casing. Cabut kabel baterai. Ganti paket baterai. Jalankan pemeriksaan kesehatan baterai.

pages.title: Keyboard replacement & key repair
pages.content: Power down. Remove keycaps. Clean debris. Replace broken domes or scissor mechanisms. For full replacement remove keyboard module and ribbon cable.

pages.title: Penggantian keyboard & perbaikan tombol
pages.content: Matikan. Lepas keycap. Bersihkan kotoran. Ganti bagian yang rusak atau modul keyboard lengkap jika perlu.

pages.title: Screen replacement & hinge repair
pages.content: Remove bezel. Disconnect display cable. Replace panel or hinges carefully. Reconnect and test before full reassembly.

pages.title: Penggantian layar & perbaikan engsel
pages.content: Lepaskan bezel. Cabut kabel display. Ganti panel atau engsel dengan hati-hati. Sambungkan kembali dan uji sebelum merakit.

pages.title: Fan replacement
pages.content: Identify failing fan. Disconnect fan cable. Remove screws. Replace with compatible fan. Reconnect and test.

pages.title: Penggantian kipas
pages.content: Identifikasi kipas bermasalah. Cabut kabel kipas. Lepaskan sekrup. Ganti kipas kompatibel. Sambungkan dan uji.

pages.title: BIOS/firmware & reset
pages.content: Only use manufacturer firmware. Ensure power during update. Use recovery tools or CMOS reset if update fails.

pages.title: BIOS/firmware & reset
pages.content: Hanya gunakan firmware pabrikan. Pastikan daya selama pembaruan. Gunakan alat pemulihan atau reset CMOS jika gagal.

pages.title: Data backup & recovery
pages.content: Create disk image or clone. Use TestDisk or PhotoRec from live USB for recovery. Prefer non-destructive operations.

pages.title: Cadangan & pemulihan data
pages.content: Buat citra disk atau clone. Gunakan TestDisk/PhotoRec dari live USB untuk pemulihan. Prioritaskan operasi non-destruktif.
